dct_creator_sm: Government of New Brunswick, Department of Environment and Local Government.
dct_description_sm:
The New Brunswick Community‑Based Lake Data monitoring is carried out by local community and volunteer lake organizations (under the NBALA) to help monitor and understand the health of the province’s lakes. Each year between spring and fall the organizations monitor lakes at multiple stations with samples taken at surface as well as at various depths at some stations. This dataset includes data from 2003 to present. The value of the data and local knowledge collected by the community and volunteer organizations is essential to the province’s understanding of the state of water quality in the province.

This monitoring program complements the monitoring done by the Department of Environment and Local Government by building on the number and frequency of lakes monitored across New Brunswick. Sampling follows standardized protocols to ensure consistency and data quality.
